# Torii: two lacquered posts, a tie beam (nuki) the bell cords hang from, a dark top beam (kasagi)
# (steel grey) with upturned ends, a name plaque between the beams, the posts' black feet and the four cords.
# Built in place: the gate stands at world z -1 (hedra y 1). Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Lacquer --base-color 0.0863 0.4314 0.4784 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 0.1451 0.3020 0.4392 --no-slot
material new Cord --base-color 0.6980 0.8510 0.2588 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name PostL --vertices 8 --radius 0.36 --depth 6.0 --location -5.4 1.0 3.0
add mesh cylinder --name PostR --vertices 8 --radius 0.36 --depth 6.0 --location 5.4 1.0 3.0
add mesh cube --name Nuki --size 1 --location 0 1.0 5.05
scale 12.6 0.42 0.6
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Plaque --size 1 --location 0 0.95 5.65
scale 1.1 0.3 0.8
apply --scale
select PostL PostR Nuki Plaque
active PostL
join
rename PostL Frame
material assign Lacquer
add mesh cube --name KasaM --size 1 --location 0 1.0 6.25
scale 11.2 0.8 0.55
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KasaL --size 1 --location -6.4 1.0 6.38
scale 2.4 0.8 0.55
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -9 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name KasaR --size 1 --location 6.4 1.0 6.38
scale 2.4 0.8 0.55
apply --scale
set rotation 0 9 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name FootL --size 1 --location -5.4 1.0 0.3
scale 0.95 0.95 0.6
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name FootR --size 1 --location 5.4 1.0 0.3
scale 0.95 0.95 0.6
apply --scale
select KasaM KasaL KasaR FootL FootR
active KasaM
join
rename KasaM Kasagi
material assign Cap
add mesh cube --name Cord0 --size 1 --location -3.60 1.0 4.570
scale 0.12 0.12 0.460
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Cord1 --size 1 --location -1.20 1.0 4.570
scale 0.12 0.12 0.460
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Cord2 --size 1 --location 1.20 1.0 4.570
scale 0.12 0.12 0.460
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name Cord3 --size 1 --location 3.50 1.0 4.570
scale 0.12 0.12 0.460
apply --scale
select Cord0 Cord1 Cord2 Cord3
active Cord0
join
rename Cord0 Cords
material assign Cord
select all
shade flat
export torii.glb
